notes.title: Devlog 3 - Enemies part 2
notes.content:
Hello,

We present you our third devlog entry. The second part of the enemies


 The clone: becomes more and more powerful, in its final version it is hard to kill so keep it as your first target! 
 The bodyguard: Dog is man's best friend, and that is why we will find dogs on the side of the XSapiens corporation. 
 The loyar costumer is so loyal that he is capable of sacrificing himself in order to defend his beloved corporation.

notes.title: Devlog 1 - Animals and families
notes.content:
Hello,

We present you our first devlog entry, the idea is to upload a weekly one telling you about the development of the game.

Today: The animals

There are several animal families that share the decks, but each animal has its own unique card. Here we present the slashers and the maulers.

Slashers

Slashers specialise in hiding, dodging and bleeding the enemy (sometimes even bleeding their allies!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137616/89dc4797d8a349b49a5e03d7481f045cc826572d.png

For now we have the cat, the panther and the lion, whose unique cards are 9 lifes, black panther and roar. You can imagine what each of these cards does ;)

Maulers

They specialise in debuffing enemies to hit harder. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137616/d66d3b2b7f98eca8b1277db06b907f75d1980354.png

For now we have the dog, the possum and the bear, whose unique cards are guardian, 
play dead and onslaught.

We continue to work on more animals and families, stay tuned.

If you want to be part of the development, join our discord channel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137616/c68e33a949adffa14b71a4c36aae9be0389d88bf.png
